title: Complexe de De Rham à puissance divisée [conférence de 1976 à l’IHÉS] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is not part of the 1975-76 divided-power de Rham notes. It is a typed page of the published SGA 7 I, Exposé IX (Grothendieck, 'Modèles de Néron et monodromie', LNM 288, 1972), page 188.

The page shows the end of §13 and the start of §14, 'Liens avec la théorie transcendante : cas rigide-analytique'. At the bottom of the scan a band of paper appears overlaid, with faint handwriting showing through ('-D(...)'). This suggests a typescript sheet that was reused or interleaved and ended up among the PD de Rham notes. The neighbouring pages are handwritten computations on simplicial PD-algebras and filtrations, which are unrelated.

Mathematics on the page:
(13.5.12) R_U / R_U^f ≅ M_U identifies a quotient of the group R_U of (13.3) with the character lattice M_U. Here R_U and R_U^f are presumably the group of points/sections and its subgroup of 'finite' ones; exact meaning unsure.
(13.5.13) The homomorphism i of (13.3.4) is rewritten as i : M_U → A^♮, to be met again in §14.

§14.1 setting:
- S is a complete discrete valuation ring and A_K an abelian variety over K.
- In 8.1, by descent from Raynaud's extension in the semistable case, one gets G_K = A_K^{♮o}. This is an extension 0 → T_K → G_K → B_K → 0 of an abelian variety B_K by a torus T_K.
- Similarly for the dual A'_K there is 0 → T'_K → G'_K → B'_K → 0, with B'_K dual to B_K (8.2).
- The lattices are M_K = D(T'_K) and M'_K = D(T_K), the character groups (Cartier duals) of the tori.

The section heading announces the canonical homomorphism M_K → A_K^{♮o}. This is the rigid-analytic period lattice embedding giving the uniformization A_K^an ≅ G_K^an / M_K (Raynaud/Mumford/Tate uniformization), set in the SGA 7 framework of monodromy pairings.
errors: No mathematical errors on this page.
Minor typo in the typescript itself: 'Nous supposons connu ici' should read 'connus'.
Grothendieck writes 'schéma abélien' for what over a field is an abelian variety; this is standard usage, not an error.

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a typed page of the published SGA 7 Exposé IX (p. 188), apparently misfiled or reused as scrap among the PD de Rham notes. Its content, the rigid-analytic uniformization setup, is published and well known.
transcription_corrections: The page is a typescript of SGA 7 IX, p. 188; '506' is the archive folio number and the handwritten '235' is the archive page count.
The symbol rendered as ♮ ('natural' sign) is correct as typed; A_K^{♮o} carries a superscript 'o' (identity component).
In 'connu ici les', the word 'ici' is hand-inserted in the typescript.
Faint handwriting (something like '-D(...)') is visible through the overlaid paper strip at the bottom and is not transcribed.
